title: SOURCE_TARGETS validated: ingestctrl sstIter.Close must close reader after iterator close error

payload.validation_scope: sstIter owns both a pebble sstable.Iterator and its sstable.Reader. Current code returned immediately when iter.Close failed, so reader.Close was skipped. The local fix preserves the iterator close error and still closes the reader.
payload.user_symptom: During local ingest SST iteration cleanup, an iterator close error can leave the underlying sstable.Reader/readable open. The user-visible operation already fails, but file/cache resources can remain unclosed until process-level cleanup.
payload.quality_gate: Medium product severity: resource cleanup leak on error path, not silent data corruption. High methodology value: the source-target selector found a non-partition, transaction-adjacent storage/ingest cleanup bug with a direct RED/GREEN oracle.

provenance.source: current TiDB source plus RED/GREEN local observer test

title: SOURCE_TARGETS retired: dxf importinto onFinished local early return is covered by RunSubtask cleanup owner

analysis: A direct onFinished-only harness can show data engine Close error returns before index engine Close
However onFinished is only called from RunSubtask, and RunSubtask has a deferred failure cleanup for local sort
When onFinished returns an error, RunSubtask invokes tableImporter.Backend().CleanupAllLocalEngines(context.Background())
ingestctrl cleanupAllLocalEngines iterates remaining local engines and calls finishWrite plus cleanupEngine best-effort
Therefore this candidate is not a high-quality product bug without an additional proof that the outer cleanup owner fails or is insufficient
source_anchors: pkg/dxf/importinto/task_executor.go:267-277 RunSubtask local-sort error defer calls CleanupAllLocalEngines
pkg/dxf/importinto/task_executor.go:371-387 onFinished closes/imports data engine then index engine
payload.method_lesson: A terminal-action source hit is executable only after owner/finalizer dominance proof. Local function RED is not enough if an outer error defer owns the abort path.

title: SOURCE_TARGETS retired: ImportSelectedRows sibling engine close is covered by deferred closeAndCleanupEngine

analysis: The source rule found dataEngine.Close(ctx) returning before the later indexEngine.Close(ctx) success path
ImportSelectedRows already has a deferred cleanup block that calls closeAndCleanupEngine for both non-nil dataEngine and indexEngine
closeAndCleanupEngine closes and cleans the engine using a background timeout context
So a data engine close/import error does not prove index engine terminalization is skipped

title: SOURCE_TARGETS retired: simplesst flushSortedKVs stat writer close is covered by error defer

analysis: The source rule found dataWriter.Close(ctx) returning before the later statWriter.Close(ctx) normal path
flushSortedKVs has a deferred cleanup block that closes any non-nil dataWriter and statWriter on error
After dataWriter.Close(ctx), dataWriter is set to nil before checking err; if that close returns an error, statWriter remains non-nil and the defer closes statWriter
So this is a selector false positive, not a skipped sibling terminal action bug
source_anchors: pkg/ingestor/simplesst/writer.go:719-728 deferred cleanup closes non-nil dataWriter/statWriter on error
pkg/ingestor/simplesst/writer.go:747-755 normal path closes dataWriter then statWriter
payload.method_lesson: The generator must mark terminal calls inside defer func blocks as deferred coverage instead of active sibling terminal hits.
